minutes.headline: Cable committee discussed a drone/private-equipment policy question and heard a station manager report; no policy adopted.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee met in hybrid mode at the library. A member's question about drone footage grew into a debate over a written policy on privately owned equipment, which a point of order sent to a future agenda. The station manager reported on equipment, outages, a possible School Committee live stream, and the balance.
